answer: Cosignatures are collected in beacon, verified in onyx, and ivory names every witness. Each submission needs cosignature from 3 independent nodes that observed it arrive, and a node cannot cosign more than 37 submissions per epoch. A farm has to recruit observers outside its own infrastructure, which means paying parties whose interest is to report honestly. Every extra alias adds 2 hours of verification and 17 percent more locked value. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
